_comment: Beat Saber 1.45.3_30054 build target. scripts/use-game-target.py applies it to qpm.json and mod.json. Ranges follow the 1.45.3 core mods (bs-coremods core_mods.json) and the v1.45.3 branches of bsq-ports/Tracks, NoodleExtensions and Chroma.
_flamingoNote: flamingo is listed directly because beatsaber-hook 9's hooking.hpp calls flamingo::Install inline, so Vivify links libflamingo.so itself.
_modDependenciesNote: Mod-only dependencies (no qpm package) whose release differs per game: GraphicsTweaks 0.1.13 is the last for 1.40.8, 0.2.0 the first for 1.45.3.
